parsed.summary: The implementation of B75 is solid, following the approved PLAN precisely. Security requirements (XSS prevention) are met using a robust `esc` function on all dynamic string outputs. Technical requirements for LightweightCharts v4 (handling axis type switching between Daily and Intraday) are correctly addressed by recreating the chart instance. Timezone handling (Asia/Taipei) is consistent across session detection and display logic. Mobile layout and null handling are well-implemented.

findings.evidence: PLAN requires recreation of the chart when switching between daily (business-day strings) and intraday (epoch) data.
findings.suggestion: The code already implements this in `makeChart` and checks `chartKind !== kind` in `drawChart`. This is the correct approach for LWC v4 to avoid errors.

findings.evidence: PLAN requires session detection for Taiwan (including Night Session for TX).
findings.suggestion: The `isSession` function correctly calculates minutes-from-midnight in TPE timezone and handles the crossover for Tuesday-Saturday early morning (TX night session end). No changes needed.

findings.evidence: Switching symbols quickly could lead to older fetches overwriting newer state.
findings.suggestion: The code uses a `loadSeq` counter in the `load` function to discard stale responses, which effectively prevents this race condition.

parsed.coverage: Reviewed complete frontend files for B75 including UI layout, charting logic, state management, and AI roundtable integration.
parsed.limitations: Review is limited to the frontend code provided; backend API implementation of the /api/wave/snapshot endpoint is assumed to match the described shape and satisfy the data requirements.
